long_biography.plain_text:
OneWater Marine’s purchase of Walker Marine Group separated Jim Walker from the dealership network he had built across southwest Florida. The buyer described the five-location company as its largest acquisition, adding established operations in boat sales, servicing, parts, finance and insurance.

A second transaction divided the operating business from Walker’s waterfront property. PORT 32 Marinas acquired three sites in Naples, Marco Island and Cape Coral, with OneWater remaining as the sales-and-service tenant. Walker had served as president and chief executive of the marina group, and the sale transferred both the storage infrastructure and its continuing commercial relationship.
